2607.15755.title: AuEmoChat: Authentic Emotion Understanding and Rendering for Conversational Speech Synthesis
2607.15755.paper_summary: Conversational Speech Synthesis (CSS) aims to synthesize speech with human-like emotional expression and contextual consistency in user-agent interactions. Existing CSS methods struggle to render authentic human emotions due to limited predefined emotion label spaces (e.g., seven emotion categories), while redundant multimodal tokens in multi-turn dialogue history interfere with context understanding. To address these issues, we propose AuEmoChat, a CSS framework for authentic emotion understanding and rendering. First, we develop AuEmoCodec, which learns a discrete authentic emotion token space from large-scale emotional speech via finite scalar quantization, enabling a more authentic emotion representation than limited basic emotion categories. We further propose AuEmoToMe, an authentic-emotion-guided token merging algorithm that merges redundant tokens in multimodal dialogue history while preserving emotion-relevant context. We integrate it into an autoregressive text-speech model to predict the target authentic emotion token and speech tokens. Finally, we propose Authentic Emotion Flow Matching, which renders speech by jointly conditioning on merged dialogue context, target authentic emotion, and acoustic priors. Extensive experiments on the NCSSD-EmCap dataset demonstrate that AuEmoChat outperforms state-of-the-art CSS baselines and generates more expressive and authentic emotional speech.
2607.15755.paper_summary_zh: 對話語音合成（CSS）旨在合成具有類似人類情感表達和上下文一致性的語音，以用於用戶-代理互動。現有的CSS方法因為預定義的情感標籤空間有限（例如，七種情感類別），而難以呈現真實的人類情感，同時多輪對話歷史中的冗餘多模態標記干擾了上下文理解。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了AuEmoChat，一個用於真實情感理解和表達的CSS框架。首先，我們開發了AuEmoCodec，它通過有限標量量化從大規模情感語音中學習離散的真實情感標記空間，從而實現比有限的基本情感類別更真實的情感表達。我們進一步提出了AuEmoToMe，一種真實情感引導的標記合併算法，該算法在保留與情感相關的上下文的同時合併多模態對話歷史中的冗餘標記。我們將其整合到自回歸文本-語音模型中，以預測目標真實情感標記和語音標記。最後，我們提出了真實情感流匹配，通過共同條件化合併的對話上下文、目標真實情感和聲學先驗來合成語音。在NCSSD-EmCap數據集上的大量實驗表明，AuEmoChat的性能超越了最先進的CSS基準，生成了更具表現力和真實情感的語音。
